meta.source: Local clone of https://haoqi.design/ (this repo). Home measured from the built clone + CLONE_SPEC.md; article and not-found templates from CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md (live recon of all 6 subpages + a 404).
meta.status: measured-from-clone — all 8 routes built; home QA'd against live, article/not-found pages verified against live recon
meta.$comment: Out of scope / excluded: /2026 and /unlock/* (passcode-protected on the original). The not-found template stands for every unknown path (counted once). External card links (Figma plugins, Friends of Figma events) and mailto/social links are outbound, not routes.

categories.SHELL: Fixed site chrome layered over every page: header HUD, status row, overlays, page-transition mask.
categories.BACKDROP: Full-viewport WebGL canvas behind the scrolling content.
categories.HERO: Page-opening composition of the home page.
categories.INTRO: Personal introduction block following the hero.
categories.WORK: Index of projects linking to article pages or external sites.
categories.CONTACT: Closing call-to-action with contact and social links.
categories.ARTICLE: Building blocks of a long-form project write-up page.

shell.header-nav.description: Fixed top row: HAOQI.DESIGN wordmark (home link) plus WORK / CONTACT scroll links and the THEME[L|D|A] and SOUND[x] toggles; collapses to a hamburger + full-screen menu below 1024px. Text turns white over the dark warp scene.

shell.status-row.description: Fixed bottom row: GMT+8 clock + temperature line (replaced by HAOQI (C) YEAR near the end of the home page only), pointer coordinate readout (click scrolls to top) and the rotating wireframe globe icon.

shell.grid-overlay.description: Fixed difference-blended SVG grid: 3–4 vertical column lines and 2 horizontal lines with '+' crosshairs, sized from the viewport.
shell.grid-overlay.scope: Home only (not rendered on article or not-found routes).

shell.scroll-progress.description: Right-edge vertical scroll thumb on desktop (visible on mount and for 2s after each scroll); circular scroll-to-top ring on mobile once scrolled. Tracks Lenis on home and the native scroll container elsewhere.

shell.transition-mask.description: Separate overlay canvas drawing a halftone dot-iris that covers/reveals the page on first load, route changes and mobile menu open, with the loader progress bar on entry.
shell.transition-mask.scope: All 8 routes (entry and every route change).

backdrop.webgl-scene.description: three.js scene behind the scroll content: blue bokeh light-streak background, glass 'hello' / cursor / 'CRAFT & TASTE' models, falling stickers, cream dot overlay, DOM-synced project image layers, giant warp-speed cursor, lens flare + fluid post with lime pointer trail.
backdrop.webgl-scene.implementedBy: webgl/Scene.jsx (+ Bokeh, Glass, Stickers, DotOverlay, HyperCursor, ImageLayers, PostEffects)

hero.banner.description: One-viewport opener: 'Design & Engineering' label, 'Thinking in systems' line, bio paragraph with masked employer slot, and the 3-line 'I BRING CRAFT & TASTE TO DIGITAL WORK' headline, over the glass 'hello' model.

intro.about.description: Portrait photo (WebGL negative-to-positive reveal) with lime handwritten signature that draws on view, plus two large statement paragraphs with inline links to reunimos™, aDrive and Teambition.

work.selected-grid.description: #selected-work asymmetric 12-column grid of 10 project cards (image drawn by WebGL with dot-wipe hover swap, optional CODING PROJECT tag, name/year/type row); 6 link to article routes, 4 to external sites.

statement.hyper-space.description: 8-viewport-tall sticky sequence inside the warp tunnel: 'Innovate with purpose' → 'Innovate with a human touch' → four floating sentences with a lime ellipse ring → 'FUTURE-FIRST ALWAYS', each with staggered per-character fades.

contact.footer-cta.description: #contact full-viewport closer: 'LET'S CREATE SOMETHING EXTRAORDINARY' scrambled headline over the glass 'CRAFT & TASTE' model, email link bottom-left, Twitter/X · Figma · GitHub bottom-right.

article.header.description: Article opener: large wide-bold title, last-updated date, hairline divider, then the project's year range (year row omitted when a project has none).

article.body.description: Long-form prose (Chinese/English mixed) with h1–h3 headings, inline links and monospace code chips, lists, rules, zoomable rounded image figures (lightbox with dominant-colour backdrop), code blocks with line numbers + COPY, and page-specific embeds (live site iframe, slide image grid, download button).
article.body.implementedBy: pages/ArticlePage.jsx > renderNode + components/mdx/MdxBasics.jsx (MdxHeading, MdxA, MdxPre), MdxImg.jsx

article.intro.description: Muted (secondary-label) lead paragraphs directly under the article header, before the body proper.

article.toc.description: Fixed left-hand table of contents of the article's h1–h3 headings with active-heading tracking; only shown at very wide viewports (2xl and up).
article.toc.scope: Article routes whose body has headings (wasm_design_utils, adrive, shore_icon); other articles render no TOC.

article.meta-footer.description: Tinted rounded 'Metadata' box closing the article: Last Updated, live viewport Dimensions and body Characters count (scrambled in), plus a 'Links' group: Home, Work, Contact (back to home sections) and Twitter/X, GitHub, Figma.

error.not-found.description: Plain '404 | This page could not be found.' message inside the article column, with no title block, metadata box or TOC.
